title: Heavy small bowls for a child’s cereal, lead & cadmium ?
text:
Heavy small bowls for a child’s cereal, lead & cadmium ?. I have been using Corelle dinnerware for everyday as it’s rated high for
Prob 65, which means it’s Very Very low in cadmium and lead.
It’s also a light weight glass that is hard to break, easy to put in dishwasher,
Easy to put away, and basically no lead and cadmium as I mentioned.
Now that I have this new corelle stoneware with a Reactive glaze , I cannot
Find anywhere that can say these are Very very low in lead and cadmium!
Actually they do not want to talk about the Cadmium!
Very disappointing.

I like the look of these small corelle bowls but I think there more the size for a child's cereal bowl. These also take up more space in the top of my dishwasher rack that is full everyday.
Although good for ice cream , and small left overs.
There heavier like Most stoneware is.

Since These are pretty heavy for everyday and I can’t get the answers about the lead and cadmium I will not be ordering more corelle stoneware.

3 stars
